title: 第1161章 尘埃落定李易脱颖而出第1158章 再登八重天梯
slug: 成为女帝炉鼎我踏上了无敌路
content_zh:
韩如雪一语落定，天地骤然陷入死寂。
合欢宗山门前方广袤无垠的广场之上，上百万修士全都一言不发，神情呆滞，满脸错愕。
所有人在这一刻，脑袋都变得一片空白，简直不敢相信自己的耳朵。
合欢宗近三千年来第一圣女，天资绝代、容颜无双、修为深厚，引得九星无数天骄争相追捧、倾心角逐的韩如雪。
竟然舍弃了轻松登上八重天梯、品相绝世、背景通天的神族后裔白齐天，选择了修为低下、出身卑微、垂暮老朽的杂役弟子石凡！
死寂持续了整整五息。
下一瞬，宛若炽热的陨石坠入汪洋大海，全场掀起惊涛骇浪。
“不可能！！我绝对是听错了！”
“圣女怎会选他？一个三千三百多岁的准神，凭什么得圣女青睐啊。”
“白神子天梯八重、契合度八十六、丹道上品圣丹，样样顶尖！这石凡除了一项九五契合度尚可，其余毫无亮点，登顶八重天梯更是身受重创，二者犹如云泥之别，韩仙子为何会选一个更差的人做道侣？”
“圣女糊涂啊，这老头怎配得上您的半分仙资。”
“曹，看到这家伙老牛吃嫩草，我恨啊！”
……
质疑声、哗然声、难以置信的惊呼声席卷天地。
无数合欢宗弟子满是不解与不甘，在他们心中，唯有白齐天、黄冲霄、洛川、赵天海这等惊世天骄，才配得上自家谪仙临世的圣女，石凡的胜出，完全颠覆了他们的认知。
在场的数十万天骄同样个个面色铁青，胸中傲气崩塌，不甘翻涌。
倘若韩如雪择定白齐天，他们无话可说，可选了那该死的臭老头，他们忍不了一点，这对他们来说是莫大的羞辱！
蛇吞星、洛川、白灵溪等一众神子神女，亦是眉头微蹙，皆觉韩如雪此举荒唐至极，全然不顾九星天骄颜面与宗门长远前程。
“有趣，为了对抗宗门新规，竟选了这样一个老头。”
姚红姬唇勾起一抹意味深长的玩味笑容。

在她看来，韩如雪如此选择，并非真心欲与石凡双修证道，只是借机应付宗门高层，石凡才准神境中期修为，资质平平，恰好能被其随心掌控。
“我不服！”
虚空中，黄冲霄周身血色煞气彻底暴走，天神境圆满的磅礴威压毫无保留倾泻而出，周遭空间当即崩裂，细密的黑色裂痕飞速蔓延，遍布八方。
他双目赤红，发丝乱舞，死死盯着立于韩如雪身侧的李易，胸腔中的怒火与杀意几乎要将自己焚烧殆尽，厉声嘶吼道：
“韩如雪！
你这是在故意羞辱我等，一个准神中期的老废物，凭什么能成为你的道侣，你若给不出一个合理的解释，我定要闹到师尊那里去。
说你罔顾门规，徇私妄断。
以一场荒唐闹剧践踏九星万千天骄尊严，不仅让合欢宗沦为整个修仙界的天大笑话，更是动摇宗门百万载积淀的根基与信誉。”
这一声怒吼，道出了在场所有天骄的心声。
上百位登临七重天梯的修士，纷纷面露愤懑，怒视李易，充斥着不屑。
直到现在，他们仍旧不服自己败给这样一个平庸老朽，更不甘心对方抱得绝世美人归，获得合欢道侣机缘。
“韩仙子，我也需要一个解释。”
白衣纤尘不染，身姿凌空而立，无半分戾气焦躁，温润如玉的嗓音响起：
“三轮角逐，我每一轮几乎都稳居榜首，凌驾群雄，恪守规则、无愧本心；还请仙子解惑，为何舍弃我，选了你身旁这位老年修士？”
content_en:
After Han Ruxue finished speaking, the world suddenly fell into deathly silence.
In the vast square in front of the Hehuan Sect's mountain gate, millions of monks were silent, their expressions dull, and their faces full of astonishment.
At this moment, everyone's minds went blank and they couldn't believe their ears.
The number one saint in the Hehuan Sect in the past three thousand years, Han Ruxue has unparalleled talent, unparalleled appearance, and profound cultivation, attracting countless nine-star geniuses to pursue and compete for her.
He actually gave up on Bai Qitian, a descendant of the God Clan who could easily climb the eighth-level ladder, had peerless appearance, and a great background, and chose Shi Fan, an old and decrepit handyman disciple with low cultivation, humble origins!
The dead silence lasted for five full breaths.
The next moment, like a blazing meteorite falling into the vast ocean, the whole place was shaken by turbulent waves.
"Impossible!! I definitely heard wrong!"
"How could the saint choose him? Why should a quasi-god who is more than 3,300 years old be favored by the saint?"
"The Eighth Level of the Bai Shenzi Ladder, a compatibility of eighty-six, and a top-grade holy elixir in the Dandao. Everything is top-notch! This Shi Fan has no bright spots except for one of the ninety-five levels of compatibility. He was severely injured when he climbed to the eighth level of the Ladder. The two are as different as clouds and mud. Why would Fairy Han choose a worse person to be a Taoist companion?"
"The saint is confused, how can this old man deserve half of your immortality?"
"Cao, I hate it when I see this guy eating tender grass!"
…
Doubts, uproar, and disbelieving exclamations swept the world.
Countless disciples of the Hehuan Sect were full of confusion and unwillingness. In their hearts, only Bai Qitian, Huang Chongxiao, Luo Chuan, Zhao Tianhai and other amazing geniuses were worthy of the saint who had been relegated to the world. Shi Fan's victory completely subverted their understanding.
The hundreds of thousands of geniuses present all had pale faces, their pride collapsed, and they surged with unwillingness.
If Han Ruxue chooses Bai Qitian, they have nothing to say. They can't stand it if they choose that damn old man. This is a great humiliation for them!
She Tunxing, Luo Chuan, Bai Lingxi and other gods and goddesses also frowned slightly. They all felt that Han Ruxue's move was extremely ridiculous, completely disregarding the face of the nine-star genius and the long-term future of the sect.
"It's interesting that in order to fight against the new rules of the sect, we chose such an old man."
Yao Hongji's lips curved into a meaningful and playful smile.
In her opinion, Han Ruxue made such a choice because she did not really want to practice enlightenment with Shi Fan, but just took the opportunity to deal with the high-level officials of the sect. Shi Fan was only in the middle stage of the quasi-god realm and had mediocre qualifications, so he could be controlled by him at will.
"I don't accept it!"
In the void, the blood-colored evil energy around Huang Chongxiao completely went berserk, and the majestic pressure of the Perfect God Realm poured out without reservation. The surrounding space immediately collapsed, and fine black cracks spread rapidly, spreading in all directions.
His eyes were red and his hair was dancing wildly. He stared at Li Yi standing beside Han Ruxue. The anger and murderous intent in his chest almost burned him to death, and he screamed:
"Han Ruxue!
You are deliberately humiliating us. Why can an old loser in the middle stage of quasi-god become your Taoist companion? If you can't give a reasonable explanation, I will definitely go to Master.
He said that you ignored the rules of the family and made arbitrary decisions based on personal interests.
Using a ridiculous farce to trample the dignity of the Nine Stars' thousands of geniuses not only turned the Hehuan Sect into a big joke in the entire world of immortality, it also shook the sect's foundation and credibility accumulated over millions of years. "
This roar expressed the thoughts of all the geniuses present.
Hundreds of monks who ascended the seventh-level ladder all showed anger and glared at Li Yi, full of disdain.
To this day, they are still unwilling to accept their defeat to such a mediocre old man, and they are even more unwilling to let the other party embrace a peerless beauty and gain the opportunity of being a Taoist couple.
"Fairy Han, I also need an explanation."
The white clothes were spotless, the figure stood in the sky, without any anger or anxiety, and the voice as gentle as jade sounded:
"In the three rounds of competition, I almost topped the list in every round, surpassing the others, abiding by the rules andYou are worthy of your true feelings; please ask the fairy to explain, why did you abandon me and choose this old monk next to you? "
